definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that something is nothing more than what is stated; emphasizes limitation or simplicity.

examples.english: It was simply that I was lucky.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単|たん}に⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{単|たん}に⟦{知|し}らなかった→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。⟦{無視|むし}した→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It wasn't that he simply didn't know. He ignored it.

notes:
{単|たん}に emphasizes limitation, indicating that something is nothing more than what is stated. Often carries a dismissive or minimizing tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {単|たん}に〜⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧: simply just ~
- {単|たん}に〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not simply/merely ~
- {単|たん}に〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦わけ→訳：01095_wake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it's not simply that ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単|たん}に: simply, merely (slightly formal, emphasis on limitation)
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧: just, merely (more casual, broader use)
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{単|たん}に: simply, merely (emphatic combination of both)
- ⟦{単純|たんじゅん}→単純：03414_tanjun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: simply (emphasis on simplicity rather than limitation)

REGISTER:
Used in both spoken and written Japanese, but slightly more common in writing and formal contexts than ただ.
